articles.title: Startup Sues Apple in India Over Feature
articles.summary: A United States startup is suing Apple in India, demanding over 160 million dollars in damages and seeking an injunction that could block iPhone and Apple Watch imports into the country over a tap-to-share contacts feature.

articles.title: Experts Warn AI Workers Are Vulnerable to Honey-Traps
articles.summary: Industry experts are warning that professionals building artificial intelligence technologies are currently susceptible to honey-trap schemes, exploiting personal vulnerabilities as these powerful new systems continue to advance rapidly worldwide.

articles.title: Spotify Founder Backs AI Fusion Startup
articles.summary: Spotify founder Daniel Ek is investing in Europa Fusion, a new clean energy startup created by an artificial intelligence researcher aimed at developing advanced fusion power technology to meet future electricity demands.

articles.title: AI and Human Both Claim Riemann Hypothesis Solution
articles.summary: Mathematicians are stunned after an artificial intelligence system claimed a potential solution to the century-old Riemann hypothesis, alongside a competing solution independently developed by a human researcher.

articles.title: Geothermal Energy Could Power Data Centers
articles.summary: New geothermal energy startups are betting that super-hot rock drilling techniques can successfully leapfrog current renewable leaders and supply terawatts of electricity nearly anywhere to solve data center energy shortages.

articles.title: Space Hardware Financing Faces Unique Collateral Risks
articles.summary: Lenders are expressing hesitation about financing space hardware if companies like SpaceX are launching valuable physical collateral into orbit, raising broader questions about funding and insuring orbital data centers.

articles.title: Bending Spoons Acquires Mailchimp for Bargain
articles.summary: Bending Spoons has acquired Mailchimp for 3.68 billion dollars, representing a significant discount compared to Intuit's acquisition of the exact same company for approximately 12 billion dollars back in 2021.

articles.title: Transcription Firm Exposes Sensitive Data Online
articles.summary: A transcription service provider used by law enforcement agencies and major tech companies suffered a security lapse that left sensitive police interviews and body camera footage exposed on an unpassworded cloud server.

articles.title: Questions Arise Over Jensen Huang's Management Style
articles.summary: Following the departure of Jensen Huang from Nvidia, fresh questions and public scrutiny have emerged regarding a corporate management style that was reportedly built heavily on fear.

articles.title: California AG Subpoenas Nvidia Over China Ties
articles.summary: California Attorney General Rob Bonta has issued a subpoena to Nvidia regarding its former CEO and business ties with China, citing red flags that could potentially have misled state investors.

articles.title: US National Cyber Director Stepping Down
articles.summary: The United States national cyber director is stepping down from the position amid a wave of unexplained technical outages reported by businesses across the country.

articles.title: YouTube Preparing Three Billion Dollar Addiction Settlement
articles.summary: YouTube is reportedly preparing a three-billion-dollar settlement with thousands of school districts to resolve claims that its addictive platform design harmed children, which would also introduce new safeguards for teens.

articles.title: Rockstar Games Reports Massive GTA VI Launch
articles.summary: Rockstar Games announced that Grand Theft Auto VI generated 3.79 billion dollars in sales on its very first day, setting an all-time entertainment record alongside 32.5 million pre-ordered copies sold.

articles.title: Trump Threatens Heavy Tax on Foreign Data Centers
articles.summary: President Donald Trump stated he will enforce a tremendous tax penalty on American companies that choose to build artificial intelligence data centers outside of the United States.

articles.title: Google to Retire Assistant on Smart Speakers
articles.summary: Google announced plans to shut down the standalone Nest app for the Google Home app and retire Google Assistant on its smart home devices, setting a transition timeline that extends through early 2027.

articles.title: Anthropic Mathematician Claims Major Proof Using AI
articles.summary: An Anthropic mathematician claims to have solved the famous Riemann hypothesis using the Claude AI assistant, marking a potentially historic milestone for artificial intelligence applications in advanced mathematics.

articles.title: FCC Blocks California Phone Service Enforcement
articles.summary: The Trump administration's Federal Communications Commission has moved to preempt state-level regulations that would have required telecom providers like AT&T to continue maintaining home phone service rules.

articles.title: Google Redesigns Search Homepage With AI Focus
articles.summary: Google is rolling out a revised search homepage that prominently features AI chat history while completely removing the traditional search button for a more conversational user experience.

articles.title: Meta Reconsiders Net-Zero Goal Due to AI Emissions
articles.summary: Meta is actively re-evaluating its 2030 sustainability targets as greenhouse gas emissions rise significantly due to the massive power demands of running new artificial intelligence data centers.

articles.title: Researcher Exposes AI Supply Chain Privacy Flaws
articles.summary: A security researcher planted trackable canary secrets into the artificial intelligence supply chain to test data confidentiality, revealing that supposedly private user inputs can easily be exposed.

articles.title: Astronomers Observe Star Swallowing Neighbor
articles.summary: Recent space observations reveal that a sudden cosmic brightening was caused by a star that was orbiting inside a larger neighboring star before ultimately being swallowed and exploding.

articles.title: Prisons Allowed to Jam Contraband Phones
articles.summary: Prisons have received approval to use cellular jamming equipment to block contraband devices, though industry groups warn that the signals will inadvertently interfere with nearby consumer cell phones up to miles away.

articles.title: Army Delays Detonation of Hazardous Lead Azide
articles.summary: The Army has delayed plans to detonate a dangerously large stockpile of lead azide after computer models predicted that a toxic neurotoxic plume could travel as far as 100 miles away.

articles.title: SpaceX Bondholders Object to Orbital Collateral
articles.summary: Lenders holding SpaceX debt are raising concerns that valuable microchip collateral is being launched into orbit on rockets, demanding that assets remain physically accessible on Earth.

articles.title: YouTube Faces Massive School District Lawsuits
articles.summary: YouTube is confronting a growing wave of lawsuits from school districts alleging that its video platform utilizes intentionally addictive design features that have caused psychological harm to teenagers.
